name: Straightup Resources Inc.
summary: Straightup Resources Inc. engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for copper and molybdenum deposits. It holds interests in the Hi-Mars property that comprise 11 contiguous mineral titles covering a total area of 1,788 hectares located northeast of the City of Powell River in southwestern British Columbia. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
